fusions.name: Hold and Close
fusions.desc: Fixes the first enemy in line with a stare that deals 12 damage and stuns it for 1.5 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: No Blind Side
fusions.desc: Kicks at everything around you, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each [Exposed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Open Country
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Wide-Set Watch

riders.text: you see the blow before it starts
and the ground ahead before you reach it
and you are ready again sooner

fusions.desc: Raises your Spirit by 1, and your Spirit ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your dodge chance rises by 4%, from silver you move 4% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 5% sooner.
